title: Nixon on whether the CIA conspired to remove him

tellings.quote: I don't know uh I know many people think so uh I would would say that I've had it found it difficult to understand why the CIA which apparently had Advanced knowledge of the break-in uh didn't inform me

plain: Richard Nixon, the former US president, was asked whether the CIA, America's foreign spy agency, worked to push him out of office. In a recording Michels plays, Nixon says he doesn't know, that "many people think so," but that he found it hard to understand why the CIA, "which apparently had advanced knowledge of the break-in," meaning the 1972 burglary behind the Watergate scandal that brought down his presidency, never told him. If the CIA did know in advance, it would raise the question of whether the agency let his downfall happen.
